overview.description: The Horizon Core Bond ETF (BNDY) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in investment grade fixed income. The fund is actively managed, investing in investment grade, fixed income securities including US government and corporate bonds, and employing put spread overlays. Its strategy seeks total return by enhancing the portfolios return potential while managing downside risk. BNDY was launched on Jul 2, 2025 and is issued by Horizon.

data.text: CHARLOTTE, N.C.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Horizon launches Core Bond ETF (BNDY) and Flexible Income ETF (FLXN), expanding goals-based lineup, tools for advisors to meet client objectives.
